description: Return private.law's reviewed structured answer to a concrete question about one country, residence or citizenship programme, tax regime, bank or legal form — the statement, conditions and verbatim quotations from official sources with URLs and dates. Ask in natural language (the place must be named), or pass exact codes from answer_objects. When the question is not matched with confidence, found=false and candidates list the closest published questions.

object.description: Object code or name (optional); the question is then matched against that object only.

question.description: A natural-language question naming the place, programme, bank or form.

name: answer_lookup

checked.description: Actual native date the quotation was checked in the current stored snapshot; not proof of current law.

quote.description: Verbatim text of the official source.

quoteTranslation.description: Exact translation supplied by the native source record; null when absent.

sourceDate.description: The native source document date; null when unknown. Separate from quotation verification.

provenance.description: Origin of one record: stable id, clean canonical URL, publisher, the exact published revision served, a ready citation, primary sources and review status.

id.description: <locale>:<slug> for an article, <dataset>:<record id> for a dataset row.

version.description: Revision of exactly the material served: for an article the snapshot content hash (the HTML ETag value); for a dataset record the dataset revision it was published in, not the published filename. Null when unknown.

title: Look up a reviewed answer with its official source
